recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 33+ consecutive days of zero logged intake while on Wegovy is the leading unresolved risk: protein floor (≥161 g/day at 100.8 kg), energy availability, and lean-mass preservation cannot be verified. On a GLP-1 agonist, appetite suppression drops spontaneous intake 20-35% — making actual under-eating a real possibility. Protein-dense, low-volume, low-fat foods are easiest to tolerate with delayed gastric emptying. This becomes more critical as the dose steps to 0.5 mg on Sep 30.
recommendations.measurable: Protein >= 1.6 g/kg (>= 161 g) logged on >= 5 of the next 7 days

recommendations.text: Prepare for the 0.5 mg Wegovy dose step on Sep 30. Expected: GI side effects peak in first 48-72h (nausea, early satiety, possible diarrhoea), RHR may increase further (+1-2 bpm above current), HRV may dip. The 14-day dose escalation watch window opens. Avoid scheduling hard sessions Oct 1-3 (first post-injection window at new dose). Restart the RHR/HRV rebaseline clock. Pre-hydrate and eat lighter before the injection. Have bland, protein-rich foods ready (Greek yogurt, chicken breast, eggs).
